ability.name: Building Spite
ability.note: This Pokémon can MP move through other Pokémon on the field. This Pokémon deals +10 damage for each of your [CTRL FID 126,571][Banette] and [CTRL FID 251][Shuppet] that have been knocked out during the duel.

wheel.name: Destiny Bond
wheel.note: *If this Pokémon is knocked out, so is the battle opponent.

wheel.name: Imprison
wheel.note: Attaches an Imprisoned marker to the battle opponent. While that marker is attached, the Attack the battle opponent spun this turn becomes a Miss.

wheel.name: Knock Off
wheel.note: *Nullifies the effects of one of this Pokémon's battle opponent's in-use plates, and that plate counts as having been used.
